tool.name: Biomni: Query Emdb
tool.description: Query the Electron Microscopy Data Bank (EMDB) for 3D macromolecular structures.
tool.help:
**Biomni: Query Emdb**
Query the Electron Microscopy Data Bank (EMDB) for 3D macromolecular structures.
Parameters ---------- prompt (str, required): Natural language query about EM structures and associated data endpoint (str, optional): Full API endpoint to query (e.g., "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/emdb/api/search") verbose (bool): Whether to return detailed results
Returns ------- dict: Dictionary containing the query results or error information
Examples -------- - Natural language: query_emdb("Find cryo-EM structures of ribosomes at resolution better than 3Å") - Direct endpoint: query_emdb(endpoint="entry/EMD-10000")
**Domain**: database **Function**: query_emdb
